title: Recursive Queries reference solution
answer: WITH RECURSIVE org AS (SELECT employee_id, full_name, manager_id, 0 AS depth FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.employee_id, e.full_name, e.manager_id, org.depth + 1 FROM employees e JOIN org ON e.manager_id = org.employee_id) SELECT * FROM org ORDER BY depth, employee_id;
explanation: The query traverses manager-to-report edges from top-level employees. Review the query against the lab data and explain why the chosen joins, filters, aggregation grain, ordering, or transaction boundary is correct.
